item.title: Tuvalu borders open December 1st, 2022!
item.description: Funafuti (Tuvalu Department of Tourism) — Tuvalu will be opening its international borders on the 1st of December, as per the announcement by the Tuvalu Secretary to Government, Tapugao Falefou (PhD) on the 20th of November.
